variables.physical_definition: Free-stream velocity far from the wall (characteristic external velocity).
Kinematic viscosity of the fluid (momentum diffusivity).
Mean kinetic energy-like integral: integral of the square of local mean flow speed with respect to wall-normal distance from wall to boundary-layer edge.
Boundary-layer thickness (y coordinate at which local speed reaches 99% of free-stream).
Displacement thickness of the boundary layer (integral measure of mass deficit).
Momentum thickness of the boundary layer (integral measure of momentum deficit).
